dialogues.speaker: Choneaux
dialogues.text: Exclusives mean a big payout. You're not in our line of work, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Choneaux
dialogues.text: As long as I'm the only one with the scoop, I can negotiate and sell it to the highest bidder.

dialogues.speaker: Choneaux
dialogues.text: There were even some media folks who came to find me, hoping to buy out my info.

dialogues.speaker: Choneaux
dialogues.text: They said something about... how it would tarnish their reputation and cause trouble if it got published...
